g.text: Frontend on Vercel, backend on Northflank (ADR-031), data and auth on Supabase. One web service and one worker share a Redis queue.
Orange arrows: calls to outside providers. Every box below is a component named in code; the diagram shows no host region.
sign-in, RLS reads, Realtime, signed URLs
Before the job row: Presidio redaction,
Source: backend/Procfile, app/main.py (web-tier gate, routes), app/queue.py, worker/run_worker.py, worker/run_job.py, app/config.py (model IDs),
providers.py, app/page_pencil.py, app/pdf_export.py, app/research.py, frontend/lib/supabaseClient.ts, useJob.ts, signedUrls.ts, ADR-031, ADR-033.
